question: Which of the following Metals of Harappan civilization got from present-day Rajasthan and Oman?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Copper.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Copper** was one of the** main metals **used by the **Harappan civilization,** and they sourced it from present-day **Rajasthan and Oman**.
 
• The Harappans used copper for various purposes, including making** tools, weapons, and ornaments.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Tin:**

 
 
• While tin was not sourced from Rajasthan or Oman, it was an **important metal **for the Harappans.
 
• They used it to make** bronze,** which is an alloy of copper and tin.
 
• Bronze was used to make a variety of objects, including** tools, weapons, and statues.**
 
 
 
• **Gold and silver:**
 
 
• These precious metals were **not as common** as copper and tin in Harappan society.
 
• Gold was likely used for **jewelry and decorative objects**, while silver may have been used as a form of currency.
 
• The Harappans were skilled at working with these metals and produced** intricate jewelry **and other objects using techniques such as filigree and granulation.
